personalInfo.name: Ankit Kumar
personalInfo.bio: Data Engineer with 3+ years of experience building automated ETL pipelines, streaming systems, and cloud data infrastructure across hospitality, e-commerce, and SaaS. Skilled in Python, SQL, PySpark, Scala, AWS, Terraform, and GitHub Actions, with experience across Redshift, S3, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and AWS Glue.

services.title: Data Engineering & ETL
services.description: Building automated ETL pipelines and streaming systems at scale. Experienced with AWS Glue, PySpark, Apache Airflow, and Kinesis — processing millions of records daily with zero data loss.

services.title: Cloud Data Infrastructure
services.description: Designing and provisioning cloud data infrastructure on AWS using Terraform and GitHub Actions CI/CD. Expertise in Redshift, S3, Lambda, and Glue for scalable data warehousing solutions.

experience.description: Implemented Terraform + GitHub Actions CI/CD for AWS Lambda deployments. Migrated 65+ AWS Glue jobs into a systematic, pipeline-oriented Git repository with 300+ unit and integration tests. Rewrote customer deduplication pipeline using PySpark with BFS for scalable graph traversal. Resolved intermittent Tableau data-source refresh failures by migrating to controlled sequential execution.

Led a team of 4 Data Engineers designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines and ETL processes for an e-commerce and SaaS platform. Built scalable real-time event ingestion using AWS Kinesis and Lambda, processing 5M+ daily records with zero data loss. Architected 10+ AWS Glue (PySpark) and Python ETL pipelines covering 500,000+ SKUs; migrated legacy MongoDB records into centralized Redshift/PostgreSQL warehouses.

Built Python-based REST API ingestion pipelines into PostgreSQL, processing 50K+ records daily with validation, deduplication, and SQL reporting views. Leveraged Firebase Analytics event data to identify user drop-offs, contributing to a 21% improvement in retention. Archived processed exports to AWS S3 for audit compliance and versioned backup.

Built Python and Pandas pipelines to clean, deduplicate, and schema-normalize 100K+ records of raw activity data. Automated PostgreSQL loading and eliminated 10+ hours/week of manual reporting effort.
